name: Couch Stretch
notes:
### 🎯 Target / Focus
Hip flexor relief, pelvic tilt alignment.

### ⏱️ Duration
**2 min per side** *(4 min total)*

### 📋 Execution
- Place knee against wall or couch
- Step front foot forward
- Squeeze rear glute tightly

name: Taube / Pigeon Pose
notes:
### 🎯 Target / Focus
Stretch glutes & piriformis, relieve SI joint.

### ⏱️ Duration
**1.5–2 min per side** *(3–4 min total)*

### 📋 Execution
- Front leg bent across body
- Back leg straight behind
- Lean chest forward with control

name: 90/90 Hüftrotation
notes:
### 🎯 Target / Focus
Internal & external hip mobility.

### ⏱️ Duration
**1.5–2 min** *(dynamic)*

### 📋 Execution
- Sit on floor with both legs bent at **90 degrees**
- Rotate smoothly side to side

name: Triggerpunkt-Behandlung (Gluteus & Piriformis)
notes:
### 🎯 Target / Focus
Release myofascial trigger points in glutes.

### ⏱️ Duration
**2–3 min**

### 📋 Execution
- Sit on lacrosse ball on glute
- Find tender spots
- Hold **30–60s** with deep breathing

name: Plank mit Beckenkippung (Posterior Pelvic Tilt)
notes:
### 🎯 Target / Focus
Core activation and pelvic stabilization.

### ⏱️ Duration
**2 sets of 45s**

### 📋 Execution
- Forearm plank
- Actively tuck pelvis under
- Squeeze glutes and pull navel inward

name: BWS-Extension (auf Faszienrolle)
notes:
### 🎯 Target / Focus
Thoracic extension to counter slouching.

### ⏱️ Duration
**2 min** *(10–12 reps)*

### 📋 Execution
- Foam roller under mid back
- Hands behind head
- Gently extend backward over roller

name: Thorax-Rotation (Open Book / Buch öffnen)
notes:
### 🎯 Target / Focus
Thoracic spine rotation.

### ⏱️ Duration
**10 reps per side** *(approx. 2–3 min)*

### 📋 Execution
- Side-lying, knees at **90°**
- Open top arm in wide arc backward
- Eyes follow hand

name: Doorway Chest Stretch (Brustöffner)
notes:
### 🎯 Target / Focus
Chest & shoulder opener.

### ⏱️ Duration
**1–1.5 min per side** *(3 min total)*

### 📋 Execution
- Place forearm on door frame
- Step forward
- Rotate torso slightly until stretch is felt

name: Chin Tucks & Wall Slides
notes:
### 🎯 Target / Focus
Deep neck flexors & lower trap activation.

### ⏱️ Duration
**2 sets of 12 reps**

### 📋 Execution
- **Chin tucks:** Create double chin against resistance
- **Wall slides:** Slide arms up wall smoothly

name: Faszienbehandlung (Oberer Rücken)
notes:
### 🎯 Target / Focus
Relieve upper back tension along spine.

### ⏱️ Duration
**3 min**

### 📋 Execution
- Roll out muscles along spine with peanut ball
- **Note:** Avoid spinal bones directly

name: Katze-Kuh & Threading the Needle
notes:
### 🎯 Target / Focus
Spine warm-up and mobility.

### ⏱️ Duration
**10 reps**

### 📋 Execution
- Hands and knees, alternate between arching and rounding back
- Thread arm through underneath

name: Glute Bridge mit Miniband
notes:
### 🎯 Target / Focus
Glute activation before heavy squats or deadlifts.

### ⏱️ Duration
**2 sets of 15 reps**

### 📋 Execution
- Lie on back with miniband above knees
- Push knees outward
- Lift hips to full extension

name: Pallof Press / Deadbugs
notes:
### 🎯 Target / Focus
Anti-rotation & core stability.

### ⏱️ Duration
**2 sets of 10–12 reps**

### 📋 Execution
- **Pallof Press:** Cable/band anti-rotation press
- **Deadbug:** Lower opposite arm and leg while lower back stays flat

name: Dynamische Hüftkreise & Beinschwünge
notes:
### 🎯 Target / Focus
Dynamic hip range of motion warm-up.

### ⏱️ Duration
**10–12 reps per side**

### 📋 Execution
- Stand on one leg
- Swing free leg forward/back with control
- Perform wide hip circles
